mapper.select: SELECT o.*, t.* FROM ( SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status='PENDING' THEN 1 END) AS outbox_pending, COUNT(CASE WHEN status='PENDING' AND attempt_count>0 THEN 1 END) AS outbox_retrying, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='SENT' THEN GREATEST(attempt_count-1,0) ELSE attempt_count END),0) AS stored_failed_attempts, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN status='PENDING' THEN GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,created_at,#{now}),0) END),0) AS oldest_pending_seconds FROM order_timeout_outbox ) o CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status='PENDING_PAYMENT' AND expires_at<=#{now} THEN 1 END) AS overdue_orders, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN status='PENDING_PAYMENT' AND expires_at<=#{now} THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,expires_at,#{now}) END),0) AS oldest_overdue_seconds, COUNT(CASE WHEN status='CLOSED' AND ended_at BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{now},INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AND #{now} THEN 1 END) AS closed_last_hour, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN status='CLOSED' AND ended_at BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{now},INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AND #{now} THEN GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,expires_at,ended_at),0) END),0) AS closed_last_hour_max_delay_seconds FROM trade_order ) t
